_comment: Copy to trace.config.json and edit. The file is OPTIONAL and gitignored —
without it the kit runs standalone with the defaults shown below.
Every key can also be set per-run via an environment variable.
outputDir      TRACE_OUT_DIR       where .zip/.log go. Relative = inside the kit.
defaultUrl     TRACE_DEFAULT_URL   used when no URL is given on the command line.
taskPattern    TRACE_TASK_PATTERN  regex for --task. Any ticket scheme, or leave
the permissive default. A task is always optional.
taskInFilename                     prefix artifacts with the task number.
dashboardUrl   ODOO_DASHBOARD_URL  only used to resolve --session-id into a task.
